items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: playing with Carl Saunders, a friend of mine.

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Like what do you like to sing?

Oh well I like to sing, as I say my girlfriend would usually tell me I sound better when I sing up tunes, like happy tunes. Like I do “Lady Be Good” “Avalon” what are some of the other ones I do? Up tunes that I can scat on. “Indiana.” I like to sing all the pretty © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-

ballads like, oh the past few days, “My Funny Valentine” about four times. Once as a bossa nova or a ballad, so I like to sing the lyrics, it’s nice. I may not be a Frank Sinatra or whatever it is, but it seems like I get some good response singing and also instrumentally, I’m getting some good response, and also I’m playing baritone lately, and that’s why I brought some of the things. There’s a few people here that you probably didn’t interview, playing with Carl Saunders, a friend of mine. He is getting a few…
